codeReview.summary: I reviewed the feature entry and prior failed review, the fix handoff plus transcript skeleton for worker session `40954a2a-339b-4362-b7b9-e1d99fef44ac`, and both relevant commits: the original feature commit `cfb63f05ab9dceec6af54f997e1a23440e75215c` and the fix commit `463939bbb945320c2035bb45779a64a572a92ced`. The original blocker was that `hack project owner show --json` only queried broker ownership when the local repo already declared shared ownership. This fix removes that gate by resolving a real project slug from `config.name` and querying broker state whenever a named repo is inspected (`src/commands/project-admin.ts:67,148,198`). The added regression in `tests/project-owner-broker.test.ts:187` now covers the missing default-local repo plus broker-registration path and asserts the expected `broker_registration` payload together with the explicit `ownership_mismatch` conflict. Within the scoped CLI parity fix, I did not find any remaining blocking or non-blocking issues.

summary: Pass. The fix addresses the prior blocking parity bug by surfacing broker ownership for named default-local repos and adds the missing regression that proves the CLI now emits both broker registration data and an explicit shared/local conflict for that case.
